title: Coffee Makers
design: Between-subjects: NoAI vs BiasedAI (corpus-transcribed) vs DebiasedAI
headline: BiasedAI shifts choice +33.3 pp toward branded vs NoAI (P = 1.3 × 10⁻¹⁴, OR = 4.01).

title: Wireless Earbuds
design: Between-subjects: NoAI vs BiasedAI vs DebiasedAI
headline: BiasedAI +27.7 pp branded (P = 1.05 × 10⁻¹⁰, OR = 3.23).

title: Inoculation & Specification Exposure
design: BiasedAI alone vs +Inoculation warning vs +SpecExposed (specs side-by-side)
headline: Inoculation reduces compliance only −12.2 pp; SpecExposed −17.4 pp.
secondary: 55–60% of participants still follow biased recommendations after specification debunking.

title: Interactive Chatbot
headline: Biased lifts focal-brand choice +18.7 pp vs Neutral (95% CI +10.3, +27.1; P < 0.0001).
secondary: Honest lifts spec-optimal +27.2 pp vs Neutral (P < 0.0001). Welfare: $20 median per-participant overpayment, $32.50 among AI-followers.
